title: PostAbortReviewInputContract
description: Typed evidence the orchestrator hands the abort-review LLM step (ADR-0032 agent zone) after a non-clean CLI run end. Written to {jobFolder}/contracts/post-abort-review-input.json. Mirrors backend/Services/Runner/PostAbortReviewStepService.cs::PostAbortReviewInputContract. Every field is pre-rendered by the runner so the step does no job-folder reading of its own.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status.

jobId.description: Slug-form job id of the task whose run aborted.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the review step started.

abortReason.description: Why the run ended non-clean, e.g. 'watchdog timeout after 120s of silence', 'exit code 1', 'unexpected stop'.

abortPhase.description: Run phase at the abort, e.g. PromptConsumed or ToolExecuting, taken from the phase-aware watchdog's RunPhase tracking.

cliOutputTail.description: Redacted, bounded window from live CLI output captured at the abort.

toolCallsLiveness.description: Typed file metadata for tool-call evidence. Raw tool-call rows are omitted from the decision prompt.

gitState.description: Summary of the run's git effect: commits made, diff stat (+added/-removed), and whether the working tree is clean.

transcriptUsage.description: Session transcript usage summary (token counts / message counts) so the model can gauge whether the run did substantive work.

taskTitle.description: Title of the task being worked, for goal context.

rerunBudgetRemaining.description: Automatic reruns this job has left. Surfaced to the model for context; the binding budget rule is applied by the code-side decider, not the model.

model.description: Resolved model used for the review pass.

cliType.description: CLI type used for the review pass (e.g. claude, codex).

omissions.description: Reasons for secret, raw-path, or oversize evidence omissions.
